## ✨ Feature Description
A clear and concise description of the feature or capability you are proposing.

## 🎯 Problem / Motivation
Is your feature request related to a problem or limitation? Please describe.

## 🚀 Proposed Solution / API Design
Describe how you imagine the API endpoint or compute module working (query parameters, JSON request/response schema, performance bounds).

## 📚 Technical Context & Physics Reference
If applicable, cite standard references (e.g. Vallado, Celestrak, Skyfield, IERS) or mathematical formulas for the astrodynamics compute.

## 💡 Alternatives Considered
A clear description of any alternative solutions or features you've considered.
